text:
emily: Heads-up: EuroPort customs flagged a mixed manifest for our latest HW drop. They9re holding container C-73 until origin paperwork is reconciled. This hits our eu-west marketplace listings and the partner SI onboarding next week.
rafael: Ugh. Which SKUs are blocked? Any chance of partial release?
jess: Blocked SKUs: rdx-gpu-48, rdx-gpu-24, and rdx-ssd-2tb. Manifest shows rdx-gpu-48 split across two POs; customs says mismatched serial ranges.
tom: Ops quick note: we have ~16 GPUs that can be rerouted from the Dublin intermediate yard to a different manifest (takes ~36h) but that reduces buffer for dedicated customers.
emily: Can we propose splitting the shipment: release S/N 1000-1015 to the SI partner for their initial onboarding, keep remaining 32 in hold until paperwork done? Partner wants at least 8 GPUs online in eu-west by Mon.
rafael: Can we commit 8 from the reroute pool? That'd require moving the 16 units out of buffer and creating a temporary reservation.
legal: If we reassign reserved units to a partner we need a temporary addendum: 30-day loaned capacity clause + liability on lost/damaged units. I can draft a short-term amendment.
ops-bot: Inventory delta: available-rdx-gpu-16 (dublin-yard) -> can be reassigned. Automated alert will create ticket INFRA-6203 if reassign executed.
jess: Vendor (SI) already lined up integration windows Tue/Wed. They asked for firm GPU IDs for their installing team. They need a CSV sample with serials.
emily: I'll send them a CSV with the 8 serials we can commit once Rafael confirms. Quick sample: ```\nserial,sku,region,commit_type,eta\n1001,rdx-gpu-48,eu-west,firm,2026-06-30\n1002,rdx-gpu-48,eu-west,firm,2026-06-30\n...\n```\nrafael: Confirmed — we can route serials 1001..1008 out of the reroute pool. ETA for handoff: 2026-06-29 18:00 UTC.
tom: Reminder: this will reduce our available burst pool in eu-west by 6 GPUs for ~3 weeks. Need product sign-off on potential SLA impact.
emily: Product is aware; they prefer we avoid customer-facing regressions. Suggest we enable aggressive KV caching and smaller batch sizes for impacted tenants.
legal: Drafted amendment: "Short-term reassignment of reserved hardware for onboarding purposes; customer liable for physical damage during onboarding; Redwood retains ownership and may reclaim hardware with 48h notice." Sharing doc in drive.
ops-bot: INFRA-6203 created: owner @tom, due 2026-06-29 20:00 UTC.
jess: I'll coordinate SI install crew and send them the CSV once legal okayed the addendum.
emily: I'll notify marketplace team to mark listing MKT-9901 as "partial availability" and include ETA note. Marketplace-bot, can you queue that change?
ops-bot: Marketplace listing update queued: MKT-9901 -> status: partial (8/40 available). Change will publish after approval.
emily: timeline: Rafael to confirm serial handoff by 15:00, Legal to sign addendum by 16:30, Marketplace publish after legal sign-off, Tom to update INFRA ticket when handoff starts.
rafael: Confirmed handoff prep complete.
emily: Thanks all. Reopen thread if customs clears the rest and we can full-release. :white_check_mark:
